messages.subject: Dataset filtering
parts:
I have a dataset with 3 columns:
names  frequency   year
A            100           2011
B            200            2012
C            300            2012 
D             400            2013
E             500            2013


I want to have a texbox where to input name (i.e A) another box where I can select year (i. e) 2012 and some label where will be shown automatically corrensponding frequency for my selection

How to make this possible in Shiny?
Regards

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Dataset filtering
parts:
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)

dataset <- ...

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("name", "Name", unique(dataset$names)),
  selectInput("year", "Year", unique(dataset$year)),
  textOutput("freq")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$freq <- renderText({
    # Make sure that name and year are selected
    validate(
      need(input$name, message = FALSE),
      need(input$year, message = FALSE)
    )

    dataset %>% filter(names == input$name & year == as.numeric(input$year))
  })
}
